The Guild

A registered nonprofit society bringing historical armoured combat to Central Alberta: training fighters, running events and building the sport.

Join a practice Members area

Our roadmap

Where we are going

Each phase is a set of milestones that brings the guild closer to a permanent home for buhurt in Alberta.

  1. 2023

    Foundation

    Incorporation, initial fundraising, and participation in the World Tournament. The legal foundation, first partnerships and readiness for major events.

  2. 2024

    Growth

    Regional tournaments and youth programs. Engaging the community through events, youth development and regional involvement.

  3. 2025

    Leadership

    A training facility and provincial leadership: a centralized training hub and mentoring new leaders.

  4. 2026–2027

    National recognition

    Hosting Canadian championships and building a strong competitive presence across the country.

  5. 2028–2030

    Legacy

    A permanent buhurt arena and international tournaments: Alberta as a hub for historical armoured combat.

Be part of it

Membership, volunteering, sponsorship

Members

Members get discounted gear and training, early access to events and tournaments, a vote at the AGM, and a say in where buhurt in Alberta goes next.

Create an account

Volunteers

Help run events and tournaments, or mentor young fighters in the youth program. No armour required.

Get in touch

Sponsors

Gold $1,000+: logo on all event materials, the website and social media. Silver $500+: website and social media. Bronze $250+: recognition on social media.

Sponsor the Reavers

Governance

How the guild runs

The Red Deer Reavers Guild is a registered society with elected officers, bylaws and an annual general meeting. Members vote; the executive keeps the records.
